description: This bar chart, titled “The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets,” illustrates the number of datasets categorized by language for each year from 2012 to 2021, with an additional data point for 2021 shown as a grey bar. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of datasets,” uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^2, with tick marks at intervals of 10^0, 10^1, and 10^2. The horizontal axis, labeled “Year,” lists the years sequentially from 2012 to 2021. A legend in the top-left corner indicates the color coding for each language category: blue for English, orange for “All other,” green for Arabic, red for Bengali, purple for Spanish, and brown for Russian. Each year features one or more bars, with the height of each bar representing the count of datasets for that language in that year. For instance, in 2012, there is a single blue bar (English) with a value of approximately 1. In 2017, the blue bar (English) reaches approximately 10, the orange bar (“All other”) reaches approximately 10, the green bar (Arabic) reaches approximately 1, the red bar (Bengali) reaches approximately 1, and the purple bar (Spanish) reaches approximately 1. In 2021, the blue bar (English) reaches approximately 100, the orange bar (“All other”) reaches approximately 100, the green bar (Arabic) reaches approximately 10, the red bar (Bengali) reaches approximately 10, the purple bar (Spanish) reaches approximately 10, and the brown bar (Russian) reaches approximately 10. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in chronological order along the x-axis. The grey bar at the far right, labeled “2021,” appears to represent a total or aggregate count for that year and is not color-coded according to the legend.
